title: Hit probability after bounded degree padding
statement: Let $n,D$ be nonnegative integers and let $r$ be a symmetric relation on $	ext{Fin}(n)$, with $n\le D\le 4n^2$. For vertices $s,t$ and an integer $k$, if the probability that a length-$k$ walk in the directed graph defined by $r$, starting at $s$, visits $t$ is at least $9/10$, then the probability that a length-$10n^2k$ walk in the padded regular multigraph of degree $D$, starting at $s$, visits $t$ is at least $1/2$.
hypotheses_covered: The relation on Fin(n) is symmetric
The original hit probability is at least 9/10
